title: An undelivered queued checkout mutation blocks every later mutation of the same gap record with no way to inspect or reconcile it
wanted_capability: When a queued checkout-owner mutation for a record never reaches the owning checkout and published content then advances, later bbox_gap_resolve / bbox_gap_update calls on that record should not be refused indefinitely. Wanted: a surface to list pending mutations by id and target, and an operator or agent path to rebase, replay, or discard a mutation whose base is stale, so the record can be mutated again.
missing_primitive: pending checkout-mutation listing plus reconcile/discard for stale queued mutations
fallback_used: Left the target gap unresolved and reported it; the checkout carried no delivered or uncommitted change for the record, and bbox_gaps(provisional=all) showed no provisional variant to reconcile.
evidence: bbox_gap_resolve(gap-900d052c) -> error.checkout_mutation_conflict naming mutation cm-eb156f55da928432 awaiting publication, repeated after a fresh commit and push on beta/blackbox-v2 (fe79e7de)
related: gap-92bd3d34 (delivery preconditions and replay), gap-45763947 (delivered writes left uncommitted)
